fra.text: The Echoverse is the mirrored Multiverse born of Jace's attempt to rewrite reality, in which he resolves to create a new reality that erases the trauma and suffering of the old one.

Only the Theorist, the remnant of Jace, remains to build it, calculating probabilities and excising people and events from planes' histories, and he plans to lay the Echoverse over the existing Multiverse to make it stable.

Liliana warns Tam that layering one Multiverse on another will smother the souls of everyone in the original, and Vraska enters the Echoverse through a mage-ring to find details made for her, such as leaves matching her eyes.

In the end, the knife in Jace's heart ends the false Multiverse's tether, and Emrakul begins devouring the Echoverse as the mirrored plane shakes and fades, so Liliana and Vraska haul Jace's body through a mage-ring away from it.
